feature_name.value: Export filtered release readiness summary as CSV

problem_statement.value: Program managers currently copy release readiness status by hand into spreadsheets, which is slow and error-prone.

business_goal.value: Reduce manual reporting effort and give stakeholders a faster way to share release readiness summaries.

target_users.value: Primary users are program managers and release coordinators. Secondary users are delivery leads who review the exported report.

current_behavior.value: Users filter readiness data in the UI and manually re-enter the visible results into a spreadsheet for distribution.

desired_behavior.value: Users can export the currently filtered readiness view as a CSV file with stable column ordering and a timestamp.

in_scope.value: Add a CSV export action for the filtered readiness view, include the selected filters in the export metadata row, and log export events for audit visibility.

out_of_scope.value: No PDF export, no scheduled exports, no email delivery, and no historical report archive in this milestone.

business_rules.value: Export must reflect only the records visible to the requesting user. CSV column names must match the current reporting glossary. Timestamp must use UTC.

data_inputs.value: Selected UI filters, current readiness dataset, requesting user identity, and current timestamp.

data_outputs.value: CSV file contents, export timestamp, applied filter summary, and audit event metadata.

user_roles_permissions.value: Program managers and release coordinators can export. View-only stakeholders cannot export unless they already have access to the underlying readiness records.

systems_impacted.value: Release readiness dashboard UI, reporting service, and audit logging service.

api_or_contract_impacts.value: Likely requires one export endpoint or one extension of the reporting service contract to return CSV content for the active filter set.

ui_impacts.value: Add an Export CSV action near the existing filter controls and show a non-blocking success or failure message after export starts or fails.

reporting_or_audit_needs.value: Track who exported, when they exported, and which filters were applied.

error_handling_expectations.value: If export generation fails, show a user-friendly error message, do not produce a partial file, and record the failure in audit logs.

edge_cases.value: No records match the filters, filters produce very large result sets, and a user loses permission between viewing and exporting.

non_functional_requirements.value: Export should start within 3 seconds for normal result sets and remain reliable for files up to 25,000 rows.

dependencies.value: Needs reporting service support for CSV generation and confirmation from security on export permissions.

known_risks.value: Permission logic may be inconsistent across dashboard viewing and export behavior. Large exports may affect response time.

open_questions.value: Should empty-state exports produce a header-only file or block export? Should exported timestamps be visible in the filename as well as the file contents?

assumptions.value: Assume existing filtered readiness data is already available in the reporting layer and does not require a new data model for this milestone.

blocking_gaps: Export permission rules need confirmation before final story breakdown.
API contract shape for CSV export is not yet confirmed.
not_safe_to_generate: Final test cases for permission boundaries
